Brush JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime.
Built from ArthurBrussee/brush compatibility commit 3b80985709e2ec04fd6c8622a40e36473647a8e0.
360GS extension: v0.3c21 direct differentiable equirectangular camera model.
Projection uses longitude/latitude ERP coordinates with analytic Jacobian and analytic projection VJP.
Radial range is used for full-sphere depth ordering.
Training uses two complementary direct ERP seam variants per original source position, not cubemap faces.
Spherical-area and seam weights are supplied through Brush mask alpha.
Direct ERP long-edge training cap is device-adaptive up to 1536 px to retain angular detail.
c20 spherical geometry, post-triangulation pose refinement, SH1 and browser-safe GPU-only growth are retained.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
Brush is licensed under Apache-2.0. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
